synth.notes:
Mirror-axis 3x3-block game: wall axis band (rows ax..ax+2) and 3x3-block pieces with centre holes; ACTION5 cycles selection axis -> pieces sorted by (x,y) -> axis.
Axis A1/A2 = row -/+3. Selected piece A1-A4 = x-3/x+3/y-3/y+3. A move is blocked by the board bounds, by other pieces, or by landing on the axis band. Reflections: block row b -> 2*ax-b, clipped to 63 rows.
Render layers wall1<target2<reflection3<piece4. A hole shows the first solid lower pixel, otherwise its fill (selected piece 0, reflection 4, else empty). Then re-extract 4-connected components per type, targets per sprite, and name by (x,y) rank.
wall_h index = rank among walls plus visible non-wall 0 pixels. This is a hypothesis: never tested with a selected piece below the axis.
Passes 29/29 with or without hidden state. Merged pieces are split by 0-centre blocks plus adjacent ambiguous (target-covered) blocks. Movement blocking and the piece->piece/axis order of ACTION5 were not observed.
